reviews.title: Best available
reviews.text: This is the best water tracking app in the store. It’s not perfect because a lot of features are paywalled, but it has easily the LEAST amount of paywalled features of anyone else, which makes it the best. You can have up to 4 customized drinks for tracking (which I just use for 4 different sizes of water), and apple watch integration is not paywalled.

reviews.title: Fix your timing. It Sucks!
reviews.text: All of the data that I put in for my water consumption during the day regularly disappears during the afternoon. As a result, I have to go back, try to remember and re-input all of the beverages I’ve had during the day. It’s frustrating, time-consuming, and it leads to inaccurate tracking. I’ve adjusted your start and end times in your settings, but it continues to happen. FIX IT!!!

I used to use this app consistently and I really loved it then. It would remind me to drink more water and I could document the various drinks I would consume. The app updated a few months ago and I have since stopped using it, you now have to pay for drinks other than water.

reviews.title: Life-changer
reviews.text: it took a nice little app like this to really get me on track drinking water because I kept forgetting until the end of the day. The graphics are pleasant, there are many drink types to choose from and you can track caffeine alcohol, etc. if you want you, I don’t - you can set your drink amounts in ounces or ml. For instance that a cup of water for me is 4 ounces and one gulp equals 1 ounce so I know how much I’m drinking and can easily record it. I feel a lot better and internally it helps a lot of things work better. Update: several weeks later I purchased the lifetime subscription for under $20. so worth it! now I get entertained by a variety of little critters fill up with water and when I reach my quota, they pop into full color, just adorable (but can be turned off by using the lite version). It still totally helps me track with my hydration which makes such a difference flushing my system (avoiding infection) keeping me more supple and oh my skin!!

reviews.title: Great Tool
reviews.text:
First off, I don’t do subscriptions for apps, so I LOVE that there’s a one-time purchase option to unlock all the features I need.

This has been a really helpful tool. I have POTS, and it’s so helpful to be able to add custom drinks and cups and add records just by tapping the widget once. The character on the widget is also surprisingly motivating to me. The moment it goes from an outline to the full character illustration is oddly powerful. I guess I’m a simple creature. A simple, hydrated creature.

I have one suggestion. It would be great to have an option to only get notifications if I need to drink water. The encouragement is helpful for some people, even me some days, but I can get overwhelmed by notifications at times. Sometimes I only want a notif if I need a reminder to hydrate.

reviews.title: Update = DOWNGRADE
reviews.text:
Check the dates of the reviews. That will tell you when this app started going downhill. 

UPDATE: The greed continues! Now any liquid other than water requires payment. Any positive stars for this app are from when it had functionality that wasn’t blocked by a pay wall. What an unethical bait and switch. 

––

Seriously?! How greedy! You can’t take features away with an upgrade, hide them behind a paywall and think your users will be happy about it. 

I use this app daily, for almost a year, to motivate me to hydrate— not because it’s “fun” but to help me from getting kidney stones. Every now and then I need to go back and add an entry for water missed the day before. NOW, I need to pay for that?!

Looks like I may be downgrading to the previous version or use another free app. C’mon guys, this isn’t a good look for you

reviews.text: The app was fairly decent until the change occurred. Now you are unable to change the time in which you finished certain amounts of water. This change makes it inaccurate for pinning down the exact time you drank fluids. It was a small change but very important and now you can only get it if you pay. I will not be paying for that.

reviews.title: Yet another good app turned greedy
reviews.text:
I have been using this app for months to meet my water intake for my fitness goals. I liked this one specifically because I could track other beverages and it would log the water that it contains for me. NOW, all the sudden, they lock every drink but water, coffee, milk, and tea behind a paywall. Who the hell is paying for a water tracker? Not every app needs a subscription!

So yeah, I uninstalled. I’ll go find another water tracker that isn’t forcing microtransactions on me. Being healthy should not be gatekept through money and it’s awful morals to operate a business on.
